In this video, we’ll cover some of the most important Spark concepts that every data engineer and PySpark user must understand. These foundational ideas will help you reason about how Spark processes data efficiently across clusters.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
What is an RDD (Resilient Distributed Dataset)
What are DataFrames and how they are built on top of RDDs
What are Partitions in Spark and why they matter for performance
What is a Transformation and examples like filter, join, and distinct
What are Actions in Spark (show, count, write)
